card.title: Orders, payments and delivery
card.sub: Take an order, confirm the payment, and deliver it.

scenes.say: Welcome back. In this video, a customer orders from our shop. We confirm her payment, send her receipt, and deliver the hair.

scenes.caption: A customer finds your shop
scenes.say: Chiamaka saw our shop link on WhatsApp. She likes the body wave bundles, so she taps Add to bag.

scenes.caption: Check out
scenes.say: She opens her bag, and taps Check out.

scenes.caption: Name and phone
scenes.say: She types her name and her phone number. She needs no account, and no password.

steps: 15 Isaac John Street, Ikeja GRA, Lagos
scenes.caption: Delivered to her door
scenes.say: She wants it delivered, so she adds her address.

scenes.caption: She pays by transfer
scenes.say: Nfelia shows her your bank account, so she pays by transfer from her bank app.

scenes.caption: Her proof of payment
scenes.say: She adds a screenshot of her transfer, and taps Place my order. She gets an order number, and a link to follow her order.

scenes.caption: A new order is waiting
scenes.say: On your phone, Nfelia tells you at once. Home shows one shop order waiting for you.

scenes.caption: Orders, To confirm
scenes.say: Open Orders. New orders from your shop wait under To confirm.

scenes.caption: Check her screenshot
scenes.say: Check her screenshot against your bank app. When the money is really in your account, leave this switched on.

scenes.caption: Confirm order
scenes.sub: The invoice and receipt are made for you.
scenes.say: Choose when she will get it, then tap Confirm order. Nfelia makes the invoice and the receipt for you.

scenes.caption: Send her receipt
scenes.sub: The message is written for you.
scenes.say: Tap WhatsApp to send her the receipt. The message is already written, with the link to her receipt.

scenes.caption: Send it out
scenes.say: When the rider leaves with the hair, tap Send it out. The delivery note is ready for you.

scenes.caption: The sign-off link
scenes.say: Send the sign-off link to Chiamaka on WhatsApp. When the hair arrives, she confirms it with one tap.

scenes.caption: She confirms it arrived
scenes.say: Chiamaka opens the link on her phone, and taps Confirm received.

scenes.caption: Delivered and paid
scenes.say: Her order is now delivered, and paid. Done.

scenes.caption: A walk-in sale
scenes.say: Now a sale in the shop. A customer buys a glue and edge control set. Tap plus, then New order, and add the item.

scenes.caption: Paid now, in cash
scenes.say: She is in the shop and pays now, in cash. Tap Save order. Her receipt is ready, if she wants one.

scenes.caption: An order on WhatsApp
scenes.say: Funke orders a bob wig on WhatsApp. She is a new customer, so we add her name and phone number.

scenes.caption: Online or call
scenes.say: Add the bob wig. She is not in the shop, so choose Online or call.

scenes.caption: Part payment
scenes.sub: And when she pays the rest.
scenes.say: She pays fifty thousand naira now, by transfer, and the rest next week. Choose Part now, type what she paid, and when she will pay the rest.

scenes.caption: Saved, with her balance
scenes.say: Tap Save order. Nfelia remembers her balance of forty-five thousand naira.

scenes.caption: Debts
scenes.sub: Who owes you, and by when.
scenes.say: Her balance is under Debts, with the day she promised to pay. Nfelia reminds you, and you can remind her on WhatsApp.

scenes.caption: She pays the rest
scenes.say: When she pays the rest, open her order, and tap Record payment. Her receipt updates by itself.

scenes.caption: Forgot to record a sale?
scenes.say: Did you forget to record a sale yesterday? On a new order, tap Change next to the date, and choose the real day.

card.title: Quotes, deposits and customers' money
card.sub: Quote a bridal party, take a deposit, and keep money for a client.

scenes.say: That is orders, payments and delivery. In the next video, we send a quote for a bridal party, and take a deposit. See you there.
